Acme Widgets sued by First Harbor Bank

DAYTON — First Harbor Bank has filed a lawsuit in Montgomery County Common Pleas Court alleging that Acme Widgets Inc. defaulted on a $4.2 million revolving credit facility.

The complaint also says Acme granted a blanket lien to Rapid Capital LLC in January, which the bank says breached its loan covenants.

Acme's CEO said the company "disputes the claims".
